⚖️ Ethics & Safety

Bias

In simple words

When an AI system treats some people or groups unfairly, often because of unbalanced training data.

When an AI system treats some people or groups unfairly, often because its training data was unbalanced or reflected human prejudices.

Example. A face-recognition system trained mostly on photos of people with light skin can make more mistakes with people who have darker skin.

Lessons that teach it

  • Lesson 6: AI Ethics & Safety
  • Lesson 11: Can You Trust AI?
  • Lesson 13: Data: The Fuel of AI

Related words

  • DatasetA large, organised collection of examples used to train or test an AI model.
  • ProxyA piece of data that indirectly gives away something else, so a model can learn a bias it was never shown directly.
  • Black boxA system whose inner workings are hard to see or explain, even for the people who built it.
  • EU AI ActThe European Union's law on artificial intelligence, adopted in 2024 and often called the world's first broad AI law.
